name: 80513 · Berthoud, CO
findings: ZIP 80513 (Berthoud) has 63 nonprofit organizations. 31 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 25 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 80513 (Berthoud) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
35% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
